description: This file defines API endpoints for managing orders in an e-commerce backend, including listing orders, retrieving a specific order, and updating the status of an order. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order in the database.

classes.name: OrderItem
classes.description: Represents an item within an order.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product available in the catalog.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system.

classes.name: OrderUpdateStatus
classes.description: Schema for updating the status of an order.

methods.name: list_orders(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all orders for the current user.

methods.name: get_order(order_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific order by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_order_status( order_id: int, payload: OrderUpdateStatus, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update the status of an order.

ctags.pattern: /^def list_orders(db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user)):$/
